options.name: label
options.description: Accessible name of the list (and of the scroll region when horizontal).

options.name: items
options.description: Items in display order: { id, title, time?, description?, tone?, status?, icon?, avatar?, href?, actions? }.

options.name: order
options.description: Order of items; older items collapse and load at the older end.

options.name: initialVisible
options.description: Show this many items and collapse the older rest behind 'Show N older'.

options.name: loadMore
options.description: Fetch older items; the context has an AbortSignal and the oldest item.

options.name: hasMore
options.description: More items can be loaded; an empty result sets it to false.

options.name: businessCalendar
options.description: Names holidays and non-working days in day headings.

options.name: empty
options.description: Text when there are no items.

options.name: icons
options.description: Tone markers, 'Show older', and retry icons.

options.name: layout
options.description: Items on one side, or alternating sides (vertical).

options.name: timeFormat
options.description: '3 hours ago' or a formatted time; the full date is always in the title and datetime.

options.name: groupByDay
options.description: Group consecutive items of the same day under a day heading.

options.name: locale
options.description: Locale for dates, numbers, and messages.

options.name: timezone
options.description: IANA timezone for grouping and formatting instants.

properties.name: items
properties.description: Every item in display order, including loaded ones.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge and apply options; new items replace loaded ones.

methods.name: setExpanded
methods.description: Show or collapse older items (no event).

methods.name: loadOlder
methods.description: Run loadMore as the 'Load older' button does.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Abort loading and remove rendering, buttons, avatars, and listeners.

events.name: aui-action
events.description: An item action was activated: { itemId, actionId, item }.

events.name: aui-toggle
events.description: Older items were shown or collapsed: { expanded }.

events.name: aui-load-error
events.description: loadMore rejected or returned invalid items: { error }.

cssClasses.name: aui-timeline__scroller
cssClasses.description: Scroll container (a focusable region when horizontal).

cssClasses.name: aui-timeline__footer
cssClasses.description: 'Show older' and 'Load older' buttons and the error message.

cssClasses.name: aui-timeline__toggle | __load | __error | __empty
cssClasses.description: Footer parts and the empty text.
